description: Is a journal subscription, hybrid or fully open access? Look up a journal by ISSN (print or electronic, e.g. "0025-1461" or "1864-1547") and get its publisher, article-processing charge, whether the Directory of Open Access Journals lists it, and the open-access status mix of its recent articles (gold, diamond, hybrid, bronze, green, closed), with a derived model label: open_access, hybrid or subscription. The label is inferred from article-level evidence, not declared by the publisher.

_apiKey.description: OpenAlex API key. Optional — Pipeworx supplies one; pass your own to bill your account instead.

issn.description: Journal ISSN, print or electronic, e.g. "1864-1547"

years.description: Look-back window in years for the article mix (1-15, default 5)

name: get_journal_publishing_model
title: Get Journal Publishing Model
